title: Whitespace as a UI Component, Not a Leftover
description: The foundational UI/UX principle every other design decision builds on: treat space as a deliberate, systematic tool for grouping, hierarchy, and meaning — not whatever's left over after everything else is placed.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Whitespace as a UI Component, Not a Leftover_thumbnail.png

title: Padding and Margin Are Different Jobs, Not Interchangeable Values
description: Padding as internal breathing room vs. margin as separation, and the token-naming split that keeps the two from getting swapped.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Padding and Margin Are Different Jobs, Not Interchangeable Values_thumbnail.png

title: Color Contrast Is Math, Not Taste
description: The one part of color theory that isn't a matter of opinion: measurable contrast ratios, semantic color tokens, and the exact WCAG numbers a palette either passes or fails.

title: A Color Palette Is a Token System, Not a Row of Swatches
description: Why HSL's lightness value lies about perceived brightness, how to build a perceptually even OKLCH tonal ramp, the primitive/semantic/component tiers that give each step a role, and how light and dark themes should remap aliases instead of duplicating the palette.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/A Color Palette Is a Token System, Not a Row of Swatches_thumbnail.png

title: Font Size Is a Formula, Not a Feeling
description: The math that replaces font-size guesswork: modular scale ratios, the line-height and measure numbers that actually govern readability, and the exact clamp() formula for type that resizes itself without breakpoints.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Font Size Is a Formula, Not a Feeling_thumbnail.png

title: Auto Layout Is a Constraint System, Not a Convenience Toggle
description: The mental model behind Figma's most misunderstood feature: how Fixed, Hug, and Fill actually resolve against each other, why nested frames break in predictable ways, and the exact property mapping developers need for CSS Flexbox handoff.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Auto Layout Is a Constraint System, Not a Convenience Toggle_thumbnail.png

title: Accessibility Is a Structural Decision, Not a Final Pass
description: How the accessibility tree actually gets built from markup, how a control's accessible name is computed, ARIA's real rules, focus management, keyboard patterns for custom widgets, and what automated testing quietly misses.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Accessibility Is a Structural Decision, Not a Final Pass_thumbnail.png

title: Design Tokens Are a Naming System, Not a Style Guide
description: The part of a design system that actually decides whether it survives a rebrand: primitive, semantic, and component token tiers, the aliasing chain between them, and the naming rules that keep tokens from drifting back into hardcoded values.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Design Tokens Are a Naming System, Not a Style Guide_thumbnail.png

title: Responsive Layout Is a Contract, Not a Breakpoint List
description: A spec-level guide to responsive layout: content-out breakpoints, fluid grids, the clamp() sizing formula, container queries, and the overflow traps that break real devices no toolbar preview catches.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Responsive Layout Is a Contract, Not a Breakpoint List_thumbnail.png

title: Motion Timing Is a Physics Model, Not a Preset
description: The math and physics that actually govern believable motion: distance-based duration bands, how to read a cubic-bezier curve's control points, spring physics as an alternative to fixed-duration easing, and why reduced motion isn't the same as no motion.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Motion Timing Is a Physics Model, Not a Preset_thumbnail.png

title: Dark Mode Is a Second Palette, Not an Inverted Filter
description: Elevation through lightness instead of shadow, desaturating hues so they don't vibrate on black, and re-deriving contrast ratios from scratch.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Dark Mode Is a Second Palette, Not an Inverted Filter_thumbnail.png

title: Font Pairing Is a Hierarchy Decision, Not a Personality Match
description: Pairing by contrast and function, x-height matching, and why a superfamily solves more problems than a "creative" pairing.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Font Pairing Is a Hierarchy Decision, Not a Personality Match_thumbnail.png

title: Line Length Is a Reading Constraint, Not a Layout Afterthought
description: The 45-75 character measure, how line-height must scale with line length, and the CSS that keeps both in sync at any viewport.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Line Length Is a Reading Constraint, Not a Layout Afterthought_thumbnail.png

title: Grid Systems Are a Rhythm, Not a Ruler
description: 8pt spacing grids, column/gutter ratios, and how vertical rhythm keeps unrelated sections from feeling arbitrary.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Grid Systems Are a Rhythm, Not a Ruler_thumbnail.png

title: Components and Variants Are a Contract, Not a Copy-Paste Shortcut
description: Component properties, boolean and instance-swap props, nested override inheritance, and where variant sets break under real content.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Components and Variants Are a Contract, Not a Copy-Paste Shortcut_thumbnail.png

title: Figma Variables Are a Data Layer, Not Just Color Styles
description: Modes for theming, scoping rules, the aliasing chain from primitive to semantic variable, and syncing with code-side tokens.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Figma Variables Are a Data Layer, Not Just Color Styles_thumbnail.png

title: Figma-to-Code Handoff Is a Translation, Not a Screenshot
description: How Dev Mode maps Auto Layout to Flexbox/Grid, what still needs manual judgment, and annotation habits that prevent drift.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Figma-to-Code Handoff Is a Translation, Not a Screenshot_thumbnail.png
